answers.ds-001:
To request disability accommodations at UCCS, follow these steps:

1. Apply for On-Campus Housing (opens December 1st each year).
2. Complete the Housing Accommodation Request Form.
3. Complete an Application for Accommodations and provide documentation of your disability.
4. Submit the application and documentation to the Disability Services office.

Note: An email will be sent to the student with instructions on how to schedule a meeting with Disability Services or next steps.
answers.ds-005: Yes, students with approved accommodations must start tests early enough to be finished by 4:45 pm, and online exams can be facilitated with the faculty without scheduling with the Testing Center.
answers.ds-010: Disability Services is located in Main Hall, Room 324 (3rd Floor). You can contact them by phone at (719) 255-3354 or by email at dservice@uccs.edu.
